users: mechanical-engineering researchers using AI-assisted research workflows
supported_tasks: apply documented domain-rigor checks to thermal-fluid research tasks
route research work to focused evidence, analysis, writing, and review workflows
not_intended_for: replacing investigator judgment, source verification, authorship responsibility, data-rights review, or experimental validation

required_inputs: a scoped research task and user-authorized source material
outputs: structured guidance and review artifacts whose claims require user verification

limitations: The resource supplies workflow and reasoning guidance; it does not independently validate scientific results.
Outputs depend on the provided evidence, model behavior, and investigator review.
